summary: Tested the new protected email-template test-send flow across backend and UI. Core requested behaviors passed: admin login sets httpOnly cookie, anonymous send-test returns 401, invalid template IDs are rejected, server-side recipient enforcement works, per-admin 60s rate-limit returns 429, one real outbound send to delivered@resend.dev succeeded, and temporary admin/send logs were cleaned up.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout observed after 6 consecutive failed login attempts (all returned 401; no 429/lock response).
Admin account create/delete endpoints are callable without authenticated admin session (anonymous create and delete returned 200).

minor.issue: Playbook expectation mismatch: helper exits when any admin exists; it does not reconcile/update existing seeded admin password/hash changes.

integration_issues.issue: Send-test button visibility/disable logic was verified, but runtime success/error toast firing on click was not re-executed in UI to avoid additional outbound email beyond the single permitted delivery test.

action_items: Implement server-side brute-force lockout/rate protection for admin login (playbook expects lock after repeated failures).
Protect admin account management endpoints with authenticated admin authorization checks.
Replace wildcard CORS_ORIGINS with explicit trusted origins for credentialed cookie flows.
If playbook compliance is required, update seed-admin behavior to reconcile existing account password hash changes safely.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is configured with allow_credentials=true while backend/.env currently sets CORS_ORIGINS='*', which is too permissive for credentialed admin-cookie auth.
send-test route correctly blocks caller-supplied recipient/subject/html by rendering server-side templates with fixed sample data and recipient from current_admin only.
Per-admin one-minute send throttle is implemented via email_template_test_sends latest sent_at check and verified via API.
Anonymous access to admin account CRUD is a severe authz gap independent of the new send-test route.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary admin delivered@resend.dev for one real send-test delivery; then deleted that account and removed related email_template_test_sends records. Also removed temporary anon-check admin artifacts created during authz probing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary story flow is passing. Re-test after fixing admin auth hardening (lockout + admin-account endpoint authorization). For UI, send button/tab behavior is verified; if allowed, run one controlled toast check with delivered@resend.dev policy constraints.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: admin login currently has no persisted failed-attempt counter/lock window logic, so repeated invalid credentials continue returning 401. RCA-2: admin account CRUD endpoints lack Depends(get_current_admin) or equivalent authorization middleware, allowing anonymous mutation. RCA-3: CORS wildcard origin in env broadens credentialed cookie acceptance across arbitrary origins.
